recognize_zh: H&E 下可見數條管壁明顯增厚的血管，管壁與周圍有均質、蠟樣、淡嗜酸性的無細胞物質，旁邊是出血與脂肪組織；這種血管壁的無定形淡粉紅沉積要懷疑類澱粉（amyloid），需以剛果紅染色確認。
features: Thick-walled medium-sized blood vessels with concentric wall expansion
Homogeneous, waxy, pale eosinophilic acellular material within and around vessel walls
Reduced cellularity of affected vessel walls
Adjacent fresh hemorrhage and adipose tissue
Fibrous stroma with scattered small vessels; lymph node parenchyma not evident in this field
describe_en: Sections show fibroadipose tissue containing several thick-walled blood vessels whose walls are expanded by homogeneous, waxy, pale eosinophilic acellular material. The deposits are relatively hypocellular and extend into the perivascular stroma. Adjacent areas of fresh hemorrhage and mature adipose tissue are present; lymph node parenchyma (paracortex) is not clearly identifiable in this particular field. The findings are suggestive of vascular amyloid deposition, which should be confirmed with Congo red staining and polarization.

ddx.vs: Hyaline change affects mainly small arterioles in hypertension/diabetes and is Congo red-negative.
LCDD deposits look similar on H&E but are Congo red-negative and show granular non-fibrillar deposits by electron microscopy.
Fibrinoid necrosis is brighter eosinophilic with karyorrhectic debris and inflammatory cells in the vessel wall.
